title: Possession is not permission: the occupation certificate risk in Mumbai
text:
Taking possession before an occupation certificate is issued is a legal risk, not a formality.
In Tardeo, Mumbai, the top 17 floors of a 34-storey tower were occupied without an OC; the Bombay High Court ordered them vacated in July 2025 and the Supreme Court declined to intervene.
Mumbai has over 25,000 buildings without an OC, and BMC data shows such societies paying about 50% more for water.
Sources: Free Press Journal (Sep 2025, Oct 2025), Zee Business (BMC data 2016-17).
In your experience, how often do buyers check OC status before possession?
#RealEstate #Mumbai #DueDiligence
